newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ share market rebounds convincingly at the close.
newsitem.headline: NZ share market rebounds convincingly at the close.

text.p: * New Zealand share market rebound gathers momentum at close
* Leaders recoup most of Monday's losses
* Unsatisfied demand may drive market higher
Price movements at close.
LAST CHG
324 +9 * NZSC cap index -5.79 at 4,386.59
286 +2 * NZSE-10 cap index +16.73 at 1,116.34 358 +2 * Volume NZ$51.8 million. Futures +9 at 1,115
685 +13 * Other movers - +8
New Zealand share prices staged a convincing rebound on Tuesday after Monday's sharp selldown.
By the close the NZSE-40 Capital Index had gained 22.30 points to end at 2,212.56.
Turnover was worth a healthy NZ$51.8 million, much of it originating from overseas.
"The market obviously had a blip yesterday. I do feel it was an end of the quarter manipulation and I think it was obviously one-off," Luke Koekoek at JB Were said.
The market was now back to where it was a week or so ago.
"Offshore people are still very comfortable with what's happening election-wise," Koekoek said.
New Zealand will hold a general election on October 12 and Koekoek said local investors still appeared sidelined.
Most of the leading issues finished with a bid tone.
"It looks like there was a lot of unsatisfied buying at the close so you might see some more follow-through buying tomorrow," he said.
Market leader Telecom gained 13 cents to NZ$6.85 and Carter Holt Harvey firmed nine to $3.24.
